narrative: The bill, on the bookwheel. A bill copied onto the back of a used plot-strip, the Rose's afternoon set down so the tiring-house can see it without going. He does not take up a cloak.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the bill and stayed in his own yard.

entities.name: Philip Henslowe
entities.context: Not in the yard. His afternoon was on the board, and that was all.

entities.name: Harry the Fifth
entities.context: Shown on bill in Harry the Fifth, not this yard
